import pandas as pd


def to_epoch_seconds(timestamps):
    """Convert timestamp strings to integer Unix seconds."""
    ts = pd.to_datetime(list(timestamps))
    epoch = pd.Timestamp("1970-01-01")
    return [int(x) for x in (ts - epoch) // pd.Timedelta(seconds=1)]
